text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH,
I'm next, it's my era now!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I won't lose!
...Wait, WHAT?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan, Doto-chan,
and Ayabe-san aren't on this course!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I almost never managed to beat Opera O-chan! But! Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
My path goes on! Endlessly!
That's why I must push forward! HAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road!
She's polished her signature
long spurt to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the main event, the Tenno Sho (Spring),
the next challenge looks to be even tougher.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: This isâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road's running had reached
an even higher level compared to last year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea what had improved her running.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "She's not just running in second or third place... I haven't looked closely until now, but this girl..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Are you still chasing after Opera O's back even now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Am I running to catch up to her?
Or...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Did she become able to run freely because they're gone?
Which is it?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I think—it's neither of those.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Nothing will change for me. I'll simply train day in and day out, climbing forward step by step."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whether Opera O-chan was here or not, now or then.
I simply keep pressing forward toward the summit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: As long as everyone... continues to believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(I see...
She's not being dragged around by Opera O or anything...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(I'll keep climbing under my own will from now on, too.
Even without a rival to aim for,
I ain't gonna slack off. Not one bit.)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (And if I continue to build upon this, maybe one day, I can even surpass Opera O...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Heheh, so that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Neither me nor Opera O have that kind of steady diligence.
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"There are many kinds of strength, aren't there?
And you, too, are a contender for the strongest..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Top Road, I feel like today's the first time
I truly understood how strong you really are.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: See you again at the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'll become much stronger by then.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I finally figured it out.
Beating the strongest doesn't make you the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
New contenders keep popping up one after another.
The battle to determine the strongest is just getting started.
choice_data_list: Yeah. And there might still be other candidates.
Yeah. And there might be other candidates too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
It probably ain't just Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's go bear witness to the Tenno Sho (Spring).
To see who lays claim to the throne!
